user.title: Beatera
user.description: Address of Beatera and the pairing code from Profile → Home Assistant (or a key from Profile → Apps and access).

reauth_confirm.title: New key
reauth_confirm.description: Create a new pairing code in the profile (or a key) and enter it here.

error.invalid_url: The address must start with http:// or https://.
error.invalid_auth: Beatera does not accept this key.
error.cannot_connect: Beatera cannot be reached at this address.
error.missing_rights: The key needs at least the rights Read and Play.
error.invalid_code: The pairing code is wrong, already used or older than 10 minutes. Create a new one in the profile.

abort.already_configured: This account is already set up.

start_mode.name: Start mode
start_mode.description: Starts a mode set up in Beatera (Profile → Home Assistant). Without players it plays where the mode says, otherwise on the device used last.

mode.name: Mode
mode.description: Name of the mode, as in Beatera.

volume.name: Volume
volume.description: Instead of the volume of the mode.

shuffle.name: Shuffle
shuffle.description: Instead of the setting of the mode.

fade.name: Fade in
fade.description: Seconds until the volume is reached.

when_playing.name: When something plays
when_playing.description: Replace it, add at the end or let it play.

pause_all.name: Pause everything
pause_all.description: Pauses everything that plays on Beatera players, or only on the chosen ones.
